graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.
nodes: ClozapineDiscussionPreparation (2 states; parents WillingToDiscussClozapine, ClozapineMonitoringPlanAvailable, ClozapineMedicalReviewCompleted)
SuicideRiskClozapineReviewPathway (6 states; parents UrgentSafetyConcern, ClozapineTreatmentStatus, ClozapineSuicideRiskIndication, ClozapineDiscussionPreparation)
graph_decision.why_this_shape: The BN-08 graph is retained verbatim (nodes, states, edges) because it is already on point for the Statement 8 question: a three-input indication flag, two parallel review-need nodes, and one workflow pathway with urgent assessment first. No latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions, all discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile. Treatment resistance is deliberately not a parent of the indication (per BN-08 and STATEMENT-08 Implementation, clozapine can reduce suicide-related risk regardless of formal treatment-resistance criteria). Demographics, PANSS totals, and diagnosis specifics beyond confirmation are explicitly excluded from v0.1; owner decides additions.

independent_examples_provenance.clinical_vignettes: Ten synthetic author-created cases (5 true-gate pathway branches, 2 false-gate, 1 unknown-gate, 1 required-missing, 1 permitted-unknown) illustrating gate behavior, missingness, and wording. Proposed template branches and clinical expectations are review candidates, not approvals.
independent_examples_provenance.numerical_fixture: Three hand-worked checks by plain enumeration over network.xml bytes, independent of the implementation under test: (1) single-row lookup under complete evidence; (2) prior-marginal P(Indication=Present)=0.101375 from documented root references; (3) transpose/asymmetry detectors on the 4-parent pathway table and the 2-parent plan table. Checks verify ordering plumbing, not clinical correctness.

missing_structured_fields_proposed.reason: STATEMENT-08 requires a clinician judgment of substantial risk; the C-SSRS gives ideation/behavior findings, not the judgment. A scale level alone must never satisfy the gate.
STATEMENT-08 requires persistence despite other treatments with reviewed treatments, dates, response, and adherence; no history field records this determination.

Acute suicide-related concern and serious suspected treatment harm need a structured current-encounter record feeding the deterministic urgent flag; the C-SSRS high-risk flag alone does not cover suspected treatment harm.
STATEMENT-08 Implementation points to modifiable risk factors as plan targets (see Statement 3); no structured field exists.
Current versus prior versus never clozapine exposure as status only (FR-14 excludes dose/duration/route/frequency); medications list alone does not distinguish current from prior exposure.
Patient Preferences section requires willingness discussion; willingness is not consent and must be recorded separately.
Implementation and Harms sections require a feasible monitoring and follow-up plan per current local guidance; logistical barriers (for example transportation, blood-work access) belong here.
Benefit-harm, contraindication, and interaction review (with the separate DDI report referenced, never substituted) needs a structured completion record.

owner_questions: Q1: Confirm the proposed C-SSRS currency windows (past-month ideation, past-3-month behavior) or supply the exact authorized form and time windows.
Q2: Confirm the gate composition (confirmed schizophrenia AND clinician-documented substantial risk AND clinician-documented persistence) and that a C-SSRS level alone never satisfies it.
Q3: Confirm that persistence is not two failed antipsychotic trials and not treatment resistance, and that no count threshold is applied.
Q4: Approve, amend, or replace the eight proposed structured fields listed in missing_structured_fields_proposed.

Q5: Confirm the required-versus-optional classification: gate triad, urgent assessment, and clozapine exposure status block on missing; adherence, modifiable targets, willingness, monitoring plan, and medical review permit inference with disclosure.
Q6: Accept or restrict the both-usage (estimation context plus hard observation) rationale, including estimation-context-only handling of optional missing inputs.
Q7: Confirm there is no prospective suicide-risk horizon (current review with documented treatment history) and that posteriors must never be presented as suicide probabilities.
Q8: Confirm the six-state pathway vocabulary and the predefined wording, including the no-argmax rule (physician always decides; no branch prescribes, doses, restarts, continues, stops, or clears).

Q9: Clarify the R4/R7/F5 boundaries: R4 is the registration suicide-risk indication; R7 is the established-case indication; F5 is follow-up no-improvement. Confirm no shared package identity is wanted.

question_enumeration.applicability: Registration encounters whose reviewed gate holds: schizophrenia confirmed AND substantial current suicide risk documented by clinician judgment AND persistence despite other treatments documented. False gate records not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior); unknown gate records needs_clarification and stops later questions.
question_enumeration.intended_setting: General adult clinician-led schizophrenia treatment review as described in STATEMENT-08. Not an emergency-department triage instrument and not a prescribing system; urgent findings follow local emergency protocol.

output_meanings.DiscussClozapine: Review prompt: the Statement 8 indication is documented; discuss clozapine per local prescribing information. Not a prescription, not consent.
output_meanings.DiscussClozapineAndAddressReviewNeeds: Review prompt: indication documented; discuss clozapine and address flagged review needs in the same encounter.
output_meanings.IndividualizedPriorClozapineReview: Review prompt: prior clozapine exposure requires individualized benefit/harm and discontinuation-history review. No authorization of restarting or withholding.
output_meanings.ReviewCurrentClozapine: Review prompt: patient presently receiving clozapine; review current benefit, risk, adherence, effects, monitoring. No authorization of continuation, change, or stopping.
output_meanings.ReviewEvidenceAndOtherIndications: Review prompt: the suicide-risk indication is not established on recorded inputs; review evidence completeness and consider other indications. Never a recommendation against clozapine.
output_meanings.UrgentClinicalAssessment: Review prompt: urgent clinical assessment first per local emergency protocol; clozapine discussion follows after safety is addressed.

question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current review with documented treatment history; no prospective suicide-risk horizon is proposed (per BN-08 time_horizon and STATEMENT-08, which states no forward risk period). Owner to confirm.
question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult registration encounter with a reviewed high-risk/persistence gate, given the documented indication inputs, urgent assessment, clozapine exposure, and parallel review needs, what are the posterior distributions over the Statement 8 clozapine-review prompts, to structure physician discussion and review?

reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline evidence rating (1B, moderate/low strength) was converted into a probability; no C-SSRS level was converted into a risk percentage.
reference_table_provenance.rule: Roots use fixed illustrative distributions (for example SubstantialSuicideRisk [0.30,0.70], ClozapineTreatmentStatus [0.70,0.10,0.20]). Indication rows: all-Yes [0.90,0.10], (Yes,Yes,No) [0.15,0.85], (Yes,No,*) [0.05,0.95], (No,*,*) [0.02,0.98]. Plan-review rows: 0.88 on the deterministic diagonal, 0.04 elsewhere. Preparation rows: (Yes,Yes,Yes) [0.12,0.88], all else [0.88,0.12]. Pathway rows: 0.82 on the deterministic argmax state, 0.036 on each of the other five. Every synthetic row preserves its deterministic source argmax without 0/1 hardness. The lookup exists only to give the validator and inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.
reference_table_provenance.status: synthetic structural placeholder only; zero clinical validity

review_notice: Draft for owner review. Nothing in this package is clinically approved, estimates no suicide probability, authorizes no clozapine prescribing action, and encodes no treatment-resistance threshold. Do not activate.

source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-08 Statement08_Clozapine_Suicide_Risk_Review_Draft is an incomplete, inference-disabled drafting lead (missing priors, deterministic 0/1 workflow tables), not an approved mapping. Nodes, states, and edges are retained verbatim; tables are replaced as documented.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph retention rationale, gate composition, periods, transforms, horizons, wording, required/optional classification, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold, a risk cutoff, or a probability.

source_comparison.assessment_reuse: C-SSRS meanings (ideation levels 0-5 as ordinal severity, separate intensity/behavior/lethality, no composite score, high-risk and emergency flags per CSSRS.md Interpretation) are reused as reviewed in cssrs-v1. No C-SSRS level maps to the substantial-risk gate by itself; severity None or unassessed can never yield gate Yes. Diagnosis confirmation reuses diagnosis-v1; PANSS totals and bands are deliberately never converted into suicide-risk inputs.
source_comparison.deterministic_tables_resolved: The four BN-08 0/1 workflow tables are documented modeler assumptions, not validated clinical rules. A generator function was verified to reproduce all four source tables exactly (8+4+8+24 rows); the package replaces them with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each row's argmax (0.90/0.88/0.88/0.82 on the deterministic state). Originals are preserved untouched in BNs/BN-08.xml.
source_comparison.guideline_gives_no_cutoff: STATEMENT-08 states the 1B recommendation and describes benefits, harms, preferences, and quality considerations. It gives no suicide-risk cutoff, no probability, no time horizon for forward prediction, and no prescribing protocol (monitoring details are deferred to Statement 7 and current local prescribing information, deliberately not encoded here). The draft therefore proposes review prompts plus a deterministic urgent flag from recorded inputs, never a risk percentage or an automatic prescription.
source_comparison.history_reuse: AdherenceConcern reuses the awaiting_review adherence_history candidate; persistence support reuses prior_treatment_difficulty_status, prior_symptom_response, and adherence_history candidates. ClozapineTreatmentStatus is resolved to exposure status only, honoring the FR-14 exclusion of dose, duration, unit, route, and frequency (see mapping_gaps.regimen_detail_conflict). Eight further structured fields are proposed as versioned additions for review.
source_comparison.missing_priors_resolved: All ten BN-08 inputs declare parameter_status missing_prior with an explicit no-invented-probabilities policy. The package adds one synthetic reference row per root (documented illustrative distributions) so the artifact is structurally complete; every runtime CPT, including roots, is still estimated per the all-CPT contract with no registered-table fallback.
source_comparison.statute_and_monitoring_deferred: No REMS enrollment gate is encoded (per BN-08 regulatory_scope); monitoring and side-effect management follow current local prescribing information, not this package.
